title: Ansible Variables
description: Root schema for host_vars, group_vars, and role defaults in this inventory. Provides hover documentation for all project variables. Variables are flat and camelCase, named <group><parameter> per the Playbook Layering spec; each group's variables live in a companion file under groups/ and are composed here via allOf. Ungrouped standalone variables (echo, env) are defined directly in this root.

echo_phrase.description: Phrase the echo role prints on the super agent and target to validate downstream Galaxy variable overrides. Role default in roles/echo/defaults/main.yml, overridden per host/group in a downstream inventory or with -e echo_phrase=....

env.description: Environment label for the host's inventory (e.g. production, staging, molecule).
